Not only does everything fit perfectly and is stuff I would never have picked out, but I feel like I’m already elevated with one box. I even opted for another box in 2 weeks because I am so excited about this. Highly recommend if you’re looking to elevate your wardrobe and have a fresh set of eyes on you. The other change that’s drawing me away is having to pay a styling fee that I’m only reimbursed for if I buy something from the fix. Things that I add to my fix that I think I might like just may not end up working out and if I don’t like any of the items I picked or what they sent me now I’m stuck paying a fee.

I understand the company is trying to save money, but you might be losing business.

Fine.

No.
“WAIT! $20!”
Still no.
“🎁 SURPRISE!!!”
What did I win?
“Another opportunity to give us money!”

The frustrating part is that this looked like it could be fun. If I’d been allowed to photograph ten shirts and five pairs of pants, gotten a few surprisingly good outfit combinations, and thought, Hey, this actually sees combinations I don’t, I might happily have paid $20/year.

You didn’t lose a customer because the price was too high. You lost one because you wouldn’t let him try the product.

reviews.title: Does not consider time
reviews.body:
The app doesn’t allow you to input how much time you’ve owned a piece, so ratings about your wardrobe’s sustainability are mostly superficial and related to brand, not whether or not you’ve kept your clothes from going in the dumpster. Many sustainability problems have to do with waste. 

A Reformation dress that you wear once and throw away is not necessarily sustainable, even though the brand rates very highly on this app. 

It’s a well designed enough app, with some cool features, but for anyone whose been into sustainability for a while, it lacks nuance. The app seems mostly like a way to encourage shoppers to buy expensive brands, which not all of us can afford. 

An H&M shirt that you’ve had for five years is still sustainable - in its own way. The most important part is keeping your clothes and caring for them in whatever way you can to avoid creating waste. 

If you’re new to these concepts the app might be fun, if not, I wouldn’t recommend it for the purposes of sustainability

- generate outfits specifically from clothes in a packing list
- update the way fabric is entered — rather than enter the fabric content on one line, you should be able to select multiple options. With so many products made with blended materials today, having to enter it differently each time is not very practical.

reviews.title: Pros and Cons
reviews.body:
Downloaded this because I liked the appearance and layout in the sample pictures. I think Whering app has done better over Stylebook in a few key factors: Whering has WAAAY better background removal, the ability to duplicate an item from within outfit editing, and better pinch and zoom ability in outfit editing - in fact better maneuverability overall within editing. But it’s not all bad. 
I like Stylebook’s outfit generator, the grid appearance, and the ability to enter sizes manually, something I can’t do in Whering. I also like the clean look. The Stylebook sorting function is top tier. I can sort by color, brand, fabric, etc. It imports decently from the web, allowing you to pick from multiple photos on some pages. Whering was very slow and also defaults to UK brands and sizes. Stylebook works better for me in the U.S. in that regard. It’s not a terrible app by any means, but I do think the background removal is awful and the pinch-zoom and options when creating an outfit could be

reviews.title: Easy to delete closet items and usability issues.
reviews.body:
This app shows real promise, but there are some major usability issues that need to be addressed.

The most frustrating problem is how easy it is to accidentally delete items. While scrolling through my closet, I tapped the trash icon by mistake and instantly lost an accessory. There was no confirmation prompt, just immediate deletion. Because of this, I also lost multiple outfits tied to that item. Months of work curating looks were gone in seconds. That is incredibly discouraging and completely avoidable. A simple confirmation dialog before deleting would fix this.

I want my item back! 😭😭😭

On the positive side, I appreciate the Kibbe-inspired body and style analysis. That feature feels thoughtful and aligned with how people actually think about personal style.

However, the AI styling component needs significant improvement. When asking for outfit suggestions using items from my closet, the app does not effectively incorporate my actual pieces. Instead, it returns vague description

reviews.title: Complete Developer Failure
reviews.body:
MongoDB (the service that allows for cloud syncing data as well as signin) announced end-of-life support for applications— and the developers did not warn a single person that this would mean all app data would become inaccessible and login would fail going forward. 

I’d been using this app for five years— every single item in my closet had been added, I use it for packing/planning every day, and now I have lost all of my data forever. 

This is a HUGE failure that reflects the developer’s lack of care for its users and for maintaining the app. This app should be banned from the App Store. Anyone who paid for Pro should immediately demand their money back.

reviews.title: 一些使用建议
reviews.body:
1:希望抠图功能可以完善下，这个毛病真的很大。有时候自动抠图把需要的部分抠掉了，但是没有手动涂抹恢复的功能，如果不用自动抠图，自己用橡皮擦一点点擦又实在太麻烦了。
2:调节图片色调的功能再丰富一下，比如调色温，可以让衣服和实际的色差没那么大。
3:拼图那里希望从相册导入的时候就可以有一件抠图的功能，不用一件件抠。
4:输入一个衣服新品牌的时候，确认了之后希望可以自动填选该品牌，就不用从列表里再重新找出来了。
5:为什么导入穿搭的时候不可以多件自动抠图啊，像导入衣服那样。
6:如果能接入 AI 就好了，现在 ai 是大趋势。有些衣服不管是自己拍还是从网购网站拿的图都不够好看，而且不够清楚，能 ai 一件抠成白底图并且恢复衣服整体样貌就好了。

reviews.title: 被这个无忧衣橱拯救了衣柜！再也不用翻箱倒柜找衣服了
reviews.body:
这款无忧衣橱App帮我彻底整理了衣柜。
核心功能是拍照上传衣物，系统会自动抠图去背景，虽然偶尔识别不够精准，但大部分情况效果不错，支持手动调整。每件单品都能记录分类、颜色、品牌、价格和收纳位置，查找非常方便。

 搭配功能可以把衣服自由组合保存，日历记录每日穿搭，回头查看自己的穿着频率很直观。数据统计能显示每件衣服的穿着次数和单次成本，有效减少重复购买。 

界面简洁无广告，还有多衣橱管理，适合家庭使用。免费版可录入50件，超出后需付费，终身会员也不贵，性价比远高于同类产品。

 缺点方面，抠图和颜色识别有时不够准确，需要手动校正；初次录入需要花费一些时间整理，适合愿意一次性梳理衣物的用户。 

总体而言，这款工具功能实用，价格合理，能有效提升衣柜管理效率和理性消费，推荐给需要整理衣物、想减少重复购买的用户。
